answer: Pay bounty hunters to unmask clones, optimistic-rollup style. Every seat posts a 30-token bond and is presumed honest, but anyone may file a fraud proof showing two seats share one operator, such as a reused signing key or the same violet avatar file hash. A valid proof burns both bonds and pays the hunter half, so running 100 sockpuppets puts 3,000 tokens at risk from a single slip. No fake identity stays an island for long; like a reef, the watchers keep growing.
